extraction.name: RoboBench
extraction.description: A comprehensive evaluation benchmark for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as embodied brains, spanning 14 capabilities, 25 tasks, and 6092 QA pairs.
extraction.creator: Yulin Luo, Chun-Kai Fan, Menghang Dong, Jiayu Shi, Mengdi Zhao, Bo-Wen Zhang, Cheng Chi, Jiaming Liu, Gaole Dai, Rongyu Zhang, Ruichuan An, Kun Wu, Zhengping Che, Shaoxuan Xie, Guocai Yao, Zhongxia Zhao, Pengwei Wang, Guang Liu, Zhongyuan Wang, Tiejun Huang, Shanghang Zhang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data combine large-scale real-world robotic datasets with curated in-house collection, enriched with MLLM- and human-provided annotations.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Physical data collection, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Large-scale real-world robotic datasets (Fang et al., 2023; Collaboration et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2024c; Wu et al., 2024; Bu et al., 2025) and curated in-house collection.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Implicit instructions are obtained by rewriting explicit instructions into demand-based requests using LLMs. Planning-level failures are synthesized by perturbing correct instructions (wrong object, missing step, wrong order).
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data filtering during construction using general criteria (image quality, task validity) and task-specific rules (e.g., excluding single-arm data from dual-arm tasks). Data are standardized into multiple-choice QA or standardized inputs.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Gemini generates structured annotations (task summaries, step-wise instructions, metadata) which are refined by human annotators. Representative frames are sampled and annotated with affordances. 20 professionally trained annotators conducted quality inspections, validating linguistic clarity, answerability, and correctness.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: A majority-vote strategy is adopted: items that all models solve correctly are removed, whereas items all models fail to solve undergo manual review and correction.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) as embodied brains across instruction comprehension, perception reasoning, generalized planning, affordance prediction, and failure analysis.
